scope: Ten additional expedition atlas maps; two minibosses and one boss per map; thirty original sprites, five real motions per creature, independent battle previews. Normal expedition placement, story/reward/save changes are separate.

creatures.name: 나루집게장군
creatures.appearance: Broad swamp crab with asymmetrical iron-banded ferry-plank claws, an olive shell patterned like an old wooden deck, ochre joints and sturdy low legs. This is an original veteran ferry guardian, visually distinct from the small mud-crab.
creatures.context: 큰 집게의 보호를 읽고 방어·강공격을 선택하는 전열 개체.

creatures.name: 갈대창백로
creatures.appearance: Long-necked pale heron with folded slate-blue wings, a reed-leaf shoulder mantle and long spear-shaped bronze beak. Slim but imposing bird silhouette, dark webbed feet, no handheld weapons or humanoid clothing.
creatures.context: 갈대 너머에서 찌르는 원거리형. 갑옷형과 동행할 때 우선 처리할 대상.

creatures.name: 범람의 두꺼비왕
creatures.appearance: Huge squat aged toad with a water-swollen blue-green back, crown-shaped reeds growing along a broad head ridge, pale weathered throat and river-stone warts. Massive forearms and wide stable hindlegs. Calm formidable face, no royal robes.
creatures.context: 물높이 표석에 남은 범람의 흔적과 연결되는 지역 대표 개체. 강타 예고를 차단하면 노출.

creatures.name: 채석망치원숭이
creatures.appearance: Stocky old ochre macaque carrying a short heavy stone mallet, dusty cream muzzle, dark knuckles and a simple rope shoulder harness. Readable strong shoulders, chipped quarry stones on the hammer head, no elaborate armor.
creatures.context: 작업장 진입로에서 망치 강타를 예고. 차단과 방어를 배우게 하는 개체.

creatures.name: 황토갑각지네
creatures.appearance: Low broad ochre centipede with five large overlapping terracotta stone plates, only three readable pairs of thick legs, dark antennae and one strong curved jaw. Angular layered shell, compact curled body fitting the canvas.
creatures.context: 층층이 쌓인 갑각으로 평타를 견디는 개체. 기존 채석면과 시각적으로 연결.

creatures.name: 단층등 거대거북
creatures.appearance: Enormous old land tortoise carrying a layered ochre quarry rock face as its shell, visible geological stratum lines, dark brown thick legs, blunt cream jaws and a fault crack down the back. Broad heavy silhouette, no buildings on shell.
creatures.context: 채석장 가장 깊은 절리를 점유. 묵직한 몸통 강타를 예고하고 차단 후 노출.

creatures.name: 녹슨 창문지기
creatures.appearance: Hollow bronze-and-rust armored gate sentry with a closed rectangular helmet, short broad halberd held diagonally, old dark teal cloth strips and squat heavy legs. Empty dim amber visor, chipped plaques, original East Asian gate-guard motifs.
creatures.context: 성벽 통로를 지키며 긴 창 강타를 준비. 무너지기 전의 수비 흔적.

creatures.name: 종사슬 간수
creatures.appearance: Floating squat bronze temple-bell jailer with two clearly articulated iron shackle arms, a stone seal face inset in the bell body and two short readable chains, moss-dark patina and a single dim amber eye slit. No long sprawling chains.
creatures.context: 안마당에서 사슬로 공격하는 원거리 개체. 긴 사슬 동작보다 선명한 준비와 타격.

creatures.name: 관문 우두수문장
creatures.appearance: Massive bipedal ancient bronze ox guardian with broad curving short horns, a huge rectangular broken-gate shield and weathered stone shoulders, dark teal patina, ochre metal edges and square planted feet. No human face, no crown.
creatures.context: 옛 정문 자체를 지키는 마지막 수문장. 큰 방패로 준비하다 전신 강타.

creatures.name: 빙엄니 산멧돼지
creatures.appearance: Wide feral dark slate wild boar with thick cream frost bristles, short icicle-blue tusks and powerful compact legs, one pale scar over its cheek. No metal armor; unmistakable winter animal silhouette.
creatures.context: 눈길을 빠르게 돌파하는 기습형. 기존 갑옷멧돼지와 체형·이동 느낌을 구분.

creatures.name: 온천연기 원숭이
creatures.appearance: White-grey hot-spring macaque with a broad pale pink muzzle, thick woolly shoulders, a small weathered stone bowl in one hand and pale turquoise damp cuffs. Readable open hand healing gesture, no mist baked into the silhouette.
creatures.context: 온천 주변의 지원형. 동료가 다치면 회복해 먼저 처리할 이유가 생김.

creatures.name: 서리갈기 곰왕
creatures.appearance: Huge aged polar bear guardian standing in a slightly hunched two-leg stance, broad shoulders, hoarfrost crystal mane around the neck, cream fur with muted slate shadows and dark heavy paws. Weathered dignified face, no jewelry or weapons.
creatures.context: 호수 안쪽 능선의 거대한 수호 개체. 곰의 앞발 강타를 예고.

creatures.name: 닻등 난파게
creatures.appearance: Large hunched navy shore crab wearing a compact broken ship anchor lodged across its crusted shell, asymmetrical pale claws, barnacles, rusty iron joints and amber eyes. Broad triangular back, not a recolored mud crab.
creatures.context: 난파선 흔적이 갑각에 얹힌 방어형. 해변의 배 골격과 연결.

creatures.name: 동굴먹물갑오징어
creatures.appearance: Short floating deep-purple cuttlefish with a broad layered mantle, amber rimmed eyes, two larger curled forward tentacles and a visible pale siphon. Four smaller tucked tentacles, compact silhouette, no ink cloud in the idle sprite.
creatures.context: 암실에서 먹물을 쏘는 원거리형. 단순 색 변형보다 촉수·관절 움직임 강조.

creatures.name: 해식굴 용뱀
creatures.appearance: Massive coiled sea-eel serpent with a dark teal body, limestone-white plated head, broad fin-like cheek crests and pale tide-blue gill markings. One readable compact S-shaped coil and stout jaws, no legs or dragon wings.
creatures.context: 안쪽 해식굴의 대표 개체. 몸을 압축한 뒤 쏟아지는 한 번의 강타.

creatures.name: 대나무칼 사마귀
creatures.appearance: Tall compact jade-green mantis with straight split bamboo-blade forearms, narrow ivory face, dark yellow eyes and folded leaf-shaped wings. Two heavy hindlegs, sharp slim silhouette, no thorns and no handheld katana.
creatures.context: 좁은 골목을 빠르게 파고드는 개체. 기존 가시사마귀보다 날렵한 실루엣.

creatures.name: 풍경날개 학
creatures.appearance: Elegant imposing white crane with slate black wing tips, turquoise long legs and two small bronze wind-chimes tied close to the wing joints, no loose dangling strings. Strong curved beak and restrained bamboo-leaf crest.
creatures.context: 풍경이 울리는 교차 골목의 원거리형. 날개 펼침과 타격을 구분.

creatures.name: 폭풍꼬리 적판다
creatures.appearance: Stocky mature red-panda beast guardian in a grounded martial stance, broad red-brown shoulders, pale mask muzzle, very thick striped tail curled behind and a short dark bamboo cudgel. Worn moss-green waist wrap, no modern clothing.
creatures.context: 대숲의 우물 마당을 지키는 힘 있는 무술형 개체. 봉을 가드에 둔 앞차기와 제자리 회수.

creatures.name: 절벽뿔 산양
creatures.appearance: Broad red-brown cliff ibex with long angular sandstone horns, a charcoal chest beard, thick short legs and pale battered muzzle. Horns angle forward and stay inside the canvas, no stone spiral ram horns.
creatures.context: 잔도에서 뿔 방향을 유지하며 앞발 강타를 예고. 우회 공간과 협곡 분위기에 맞는 개체.

creatures.name: 붉은깃 협곡매
creatures.appearance: Large fierce rust-red harrier hawk with a dark charcoal hood, broad folded wings, pale gold beak and sturdy ochre talons. Jagged fan tail and layered orange-red shoulder feathers, clearly distinct from the scree vulture.
creatures.context: 옆길 전망대의 원거리 개체. 넓은 날개와 명확한 공격 준비.

creatures.name: 협곡갈기 비비왕
creatures.appearance: Massive mature baboon guardian with a dusty copper mane, broad dark purple muzzle, long powerful forearms and a short chunky sandstone club. Heavy haunches, cream brow stripes, scarred calm intimidating face, no ornate clothes.
creatures.context: 옛 운반로 가장 안쪽을 점유. 전신과 팔의 무게가 느껴지는 강타.

creatures.name: 수차이빨 비버
creatures.appearance: Large stocky grey-brown beaver with a broad carved-wood tail, heavy ivory incisors and a short bound timber log held in both forepaws. Dark green worn rope sash, square squat silhouette and amber work-worn eyes.
creatures.context: 작업장 목재를 몸에 두른 타격형. 자연과 작업 도구가 섞인 옛 마을의 개체.

creatures.name: 수문이끼 정령
creatures.appearance: Broad wet moss spirit built around a small old timber sluice-valve wheel, hollow round wood face, two branch arms with soft teal leaf hands and thick root feet. Small water-dark stones at the waist, no full building or giant roots.
creatures.context: 수로 구역의 동료를 회복하는 지원형. 수문 조사와 연결할 수 있는 외형.

creatures.name: 잠든 수차거인
creatures.appearance: Enormous ancient watermill golem made of broad aged timber beams, one compact mossy wheel fitted across its back shoulder, iron-banded barrel torso, heavy square feet and a single dim turquoise slit face. Compact readable joints, no house on its head.
creatures.context: 멈춘 수차의 오래된 구조물과 연결되는 갑옷형 거인. 팔·바퀴·몸통이 따로 움직이는 무게감.

creatures.name: 단풍뿔 수사슴
creatures.appearance: Strong deep chestnut stag with broad compact antlers shaped like clusters of red maple leaves, cream throat and square dark hooves. One weathered bronze shrine charm tied close to its neck, mature alert face, no sparkle or leaf cloud.
creatures.context: 연못 마당을 가로막는 예고 강타형. 단풍 잎 형태 뿔이 지역 식생을 이어줌.

creatures.name: 사당등불 여우
creatures.appearance: Large feral quadruped cream-and-rust shrine fox with a broad dark-red mane, one thick curled tail and a small dim bronze lantern carried in its jaws. Slate paws and calm narrow eyes, clearly not the humanoid companion Yeonmuk.
creatures.context: 동료를 회복하는 사당의 여우 개체. 연묵과 별개의 네발 실루엣.

creatures.name: 단풍가면 해태
creatures.appearance: Huge stone-and-bronze haetae guardian lion with broad planted forelegs, a moss-grey carved mane, a weathered ochre ceremonial brow mask and red maple-shaped bronze plates along its thick back. Stocky quadruped, a single curled horn, no flames.
creatures.context: 사당 입구의 해태 조각에서 비롯된 갑옷형 대표 개체. 가면·등판이 명확한 지역 상징.

creatures.name: 흑요집게 전갈
creatures.appearance: Heavy black obsidian scorpion with one unusually broad faceted glass claw, a compact curled tail, three readable pairs of thick legs and thin muted amber seams between plates. Charcoal edges, no glowing lava puddle.
creatures.context: 검은 암반과 같은 질감의 원거리 개체. 구리전갈의 단순 색 변형이 아닌 비대칭 집게.

creatures.name: 불씨심장 아르마딜로
creatures.appearance: Stocky charcoal armadillo with a broad layered basalt shell, short pale snout, thick front claws and a small dull orange exposed core seam in its chest. Scarred dark stone plates, clear three-quarter body, no snow crystals or fire clouds.
creatures.context: 분화구 안쪽의 예고 돌진형. 열 흔적은 외형 표현만 사용하며 새 화상 규칙은 추가하지 않음.

creatures.name: 현무암뿔 코뿔소왕
creatures.appearance: Enormous old rhinoceros guardian with broad layered basalt shoulders, one massive chipped off-white stone horn, heavy charcoal legs and muted copper mineral seams. A low broad head and compact thick body, formidable weathered face, no glowing explosion effects.
creatures.context: 식은 분화구의 가장 깊은 암반을 지키는 개체. 뿔을 낮추는 예고와 강한 몸통 동작.

resourceContract.originalSpritePolicy: Keep selected originals and all candidates immutable. Only transparent padding/crop is permitted for extraction; no synthetic translation/scale as substitute for generated articulation.

quality.style: Original East Asian pixel RPG monster, muted colors, dark readable outline, clustered pixels, no gradient or smooth illustrated edges; consistent pixel size with the current30 monsters.
quality.minibossSourceCanvas: Prefer80-96px. Match actual pixel clusters, not a smooth high-resolution illustration.
quality.bossSourceCanvas: Prefer112-128px with readable large mass, not just an upscale/recolor of a common enemy.
quality.firstReview: Each batch generates one complete three-creature map first. Planning reviews originals at actual PC game scale before motions or remaining maps.
quality.animation: Real articulated idle/movement/attack/recoil/KO, no cut-off limbs/effects, no color flashing, no revived final KO frame, same identity in every clip.
